mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where UNRATE falls below 4.0%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1.1 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite HOUST above 1.1 million, or the average return in high-HOUST periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0, following a prior 3-month trend of contraction, signals an imminent economic slowdown that triggers risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.0, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% and FEDFUNDS above 2.0% signal a persistent inflationary environment that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS above 150,000 and decline in UNRATE below 4.5% signals a strong labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 4.5%, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 460,000 million dollars, combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) above 1.1 million units, signals strong aggregate demand that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS > 460000 and HOUST > 1100, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 102.0, coupled with a drop in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized, signals a weakening supply base and impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO < 102.0 and GDPC1 < 1.5%, or the joint signal fails to produce a Rank IC > 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
